paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
notes: DAMNED unequal-delay interferometer (optical cavity + fibre delay line) at Paris Observatory. Constrains oscillating scalar DM coupling to electron mass (d_me, ScalarElectron) and to electromagnetism/fine-structure constant (d_e, ScalarPhoton) in the mass range [4.1e-11, 8.3e-10] eV (10-200 kHz). Maximum reach approach treats d_e and d_me independently. 95% CL upper limits presented in Fig. 3 for both galactic DM (rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3) and relaxion halo models. No numerical table is given; limits only available from figures, so no extractable data points. Paper covers TWO coupling types (ScalarElectron and ScalarPhoton), hence reduced confidence. dm_density of 0.4 GeV/cm^3 applies to the galactic-halo interpretation. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Traced bottom-right panel (Earth relaxion halo, d_me / ScalarElectron) DAMNED blue curve.
